_comment: pickup.c lift_object():1713-1716 and pickup():784-788. A dwarvish Valkyrie teleports to the Sokoban entry level, drops a wished dagger, wishes a boulder onto her square, and picks up both from the ',' menu: the dagger is lifted, then the boulder is refused with 'You cannot get your hand around this boulder.' and pickup() stops. She then polymorphs into a giant beetle, which drops her spear and shield, and picks up all three: body_part(HAND) gives 'foreclaw' after the spear and shield are lifted. Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
